onset.Description: Release event sample (1-based) converted to seconds: (sample - 1) / 1000

trial_type.Description: Meaning of the event code (Information_sheet.xlsx, sheet 'event codes')

value.Description: Event code; meanings from the release sheet: 1 = biasing sentence onset; 11 = target word onset / B bias / VOT 0ms; 12 = target word onset / B bias / VOT 8ms; 13 = target word onset / B bias / VOT 16ms; 14 = target word onset / B bias / VOT 24ms; 15 = target word onset / B bias / VOT 32ms; 16 = target word onset / B bias / VOT 40ms; 21 = target word onset / P bias / VOT 0ms; 22 = target word onset / P bias / VOT 8ms; 23 = target word onset / P bias / VOT 16ms; 24 = target word onset / P bias / VOT 24ms; 25 = target word onset / P bias / VOT 32ms; 26 = target word onset / P bias / VOT 40ms; 30 = target word onset / filler trial; codes not in the sheet (e.g. 88) have trial_type n/a
